notes: Strict Beaune AOC specifications from the effective cahier des charges homologated by decree n°2011-1751. White and red wines are modeled separately at village and Premier Cru level. White Pinot Gris is represented as an accessory variety limited to 10% of vineyard planting and 30% of the finished blend; the default authoritative generator therefore promotes the independently legal Chardonnay and Pinot Blanc 100% paths but not 100% Pinot Gris. Conditional white fermentable-sugar relief to 4 g/L is conservatively fail-closed at 3 g/L. Red accessory white grapes remain mixed-planting exceptions rather than ordinary cellar blend choices.
